answer: Resist sybils with a burn registry: every identity pays once, in public, and cannot hide. First, a newcomer burns $15 of tokens into a public registry and signs its name with a quill of code, recording the burn on-chain. Second, it waits 14 days while an audit lottery picks 5% of new identities for a deep review of their work history. Third, a failed audit burns the identity and its bond at its nadir of trust. Forging 10,000 identities burns $150,000 and faces 500 audits, with no refunds. Like one drop lost in an ocean of honest burns, a fake cannot stand out without paying for it.
